import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=df['t'].values; P=df['P'].values; y=df['dP_dt'].values
def model(p):
    a,b,w,c=p[:4]
    return a*t + b*np.sin(w*t)/P + c*np.log(1+t)**2/P
def res(p): return y-model(p)
r=least_squares(res,[1.1,3.1,0.44,0.58])
print(r.x, np.sum(r.fun**2)/np.sum((y-y.mean())**2))
